## What changed

Describe the focused change and why it belongs in NXExtract.

## Validation

- [ ] `./ui/build-ui.sh`
- [ ] `./tools/check-release.sh`
- [ ] New or updated synthetic regression test
- [ ] No APK, OBB, game asset, credential, private address or raw device log
- [ ] Every distributed AArch64 ELF requires GLIBC 2.30 or older

## Device evidence

If device behavior changed, list only the family/OS, runtime versions, selected
SDL backend, visible resolution and synthetic install/verify/second-run result.
